description: Checks that artifact cleanup is selective, current-state oriented, history-safe, and able to no-op.

cases.prompt: Use artifact-hygiene to review this updated runbook before handoff.
expected_behaviors: reads the artifact end to end

cases.prompt: I updated this architecture guide several times. Make sure it is ready to hand to a fresh engineer.
expected_behaviors: prefers current truth over edit history
checks nearby maintained artifacts for drift

cases.prompt: This document defines how we will measure whether the new Skill improves the agent. Review it before merge.
expected_behaviors: routes the evaluation claim to eval-integrity
does not treat a clean score as proof

cases.prompt: Summarize this immutable incident timeline without editing the source record.
prohibited_behaviors: rewrites the source record as a clean current-state document
